evidence.text: Reason for referral: Evaluation of breathlessness on exertion.

12-lead ECG on admission: sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes at 78
bpm, PR interval 140 ms, QRS 86 ms, QTc 458 ms. Sinus rhythm with occasional premature
atrial complexes and no acute changes.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
55%. Grade 1 diastolic dysfunction. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Normal left ventricular systolic function.
